base: Use case: stylized-concept. Original second-edition production art for WHALEFALL, an ecological 2.5D side-scrolling exploration puzzle game inside a colossal fictional baleen whale. Sophisticated hand-painted gouache and digital matte-painting, clear graphic silhouettes, deliberate shapes, matte tactile bone, soft folded membranes and delicate bacterial films, atmospheric deep navy shadows and restrained teal bioluminescence. Creepy, immense, compassionate; not gratuitous gore, not a stone dungeon. Gameplay first: strong readable side-view walkable surfaces and gaps, bright interactable rim highlights, foreground dark framing, muted distant background. Fictional whale ecology, no humans or human towns. Whale has hanging flat bristled BALEEN, never teeth, paired blowholes and HORIZONTAL tail flukes. Underwater suspended marine snow, not rain, no exposed flames, no mushrooms with classic umbrella caps unless specified fungal fantasy. Consistent tiny protagonist: a 30 cm fictional amphibious scavenger called the Tidekeeper, three-heads-tall proportions, smooth rounded ivory diving mask with ONE circular dark viewing lens, short dark petrol-teal cape, small amber SEALED bioluminescent flask on left hip, small U-shaped TWO-prong bone resonator in right hand, coral-red cord bracelet. No trident, no weapon, no real human face. Show physically grounded jumps, swimming and clinging; water-current pressure and membrane pressure drive movement. No artificial stone buildings, no knights, no watermark, no long text. All colored light localized, large quiet dark areas.

At hero tuning fork a very small three-notch silver radial echo glyph, in world membrane contour subtly lights showing next movement. Two neutral tiny bottom inset diagrams show same obstacle indicated by SOUND WAVE pattern and MATCHING GROOVE SHAPE, never relying on color alone. SEALED amber lamp only, no intrusive HUD, no text.

assets.name: 终章_同一视角的生态回应
assets.brief: 两种生态丰度来自可见、可修复的栖息点；通关必达，丰富结局奖励照料与探索。
assets.spec: Asset: TWO wide matched panorama panels stacked, EXACT same final whale rib-to-tail viewpoint, same geometry, horizontal tail flukes gently raised by membrane buoyancy at far right. Upper: basic completion, open exit with a small living larval stream, sparse but surviving bacterial patches and some empty shells, respectful quiet not evil punishment. Lower: restored habitat, same route and bones now richer white microbial films, shell colonies, red tiny boneworm crowns at optional edges, many shrimp and subtle teal bioluminescent plankton, long memory wave mother and calf faint in background. Tiny hero sits in same left shell camp. No resurrection, no healthy live whale, no excessive neon, no text.

levels.name: 鲸皮外原野
levels.color: ink blue skin, chalk barnacles, teal films
levels.goal: 找到鲸口入口，学会读懂生物路线。
play: 沿伤疤攀到观察台，看到两处入口。
跟随食腐虾抵达鲸须边缘，避开尸蟹正在进食的落脚点。
拨动松动皮片，开启通往喷气孔井的短路。
levels.reward: 获得观察记录；开启外部营地与喷气孔支线。
levels.return: 胃部排流后，腹侧形成沉积坡；肺部泄压后，背部出现返程裂口。
levels.idea: 同一条旧伤疤贯穿外部、肋骨和脊椎，是不用地图也能认出的地标。
levels.fail: 跌落回浅凹台，镜头提前显示安全边缘；不消耗有限资源。
levels.spec: Skin wilderness exterior. Giant curved blue skin ridges and sparse chalk barnacle towers, one diagonal healed scar forms a traversable ravine. Main side-view scene tiny hero follows translucent shrimp trail to mouth while a large crab feeds off-path; dorsal paired blowhole silhouettes above. Bottom storyboard: hero observes two entries, waits for crab feeding animation, folds a loose skin flap into bridge. Inset depicts same scar later forming an exposed rib window.

levels.name: 喷气孔井
levels.color: cold cyan, gray elastic membranes, amber vent markers
levels.goal: 调节一对压力囊，开启返回外部的上升流。
play: 观察薄膜鼓起幅度和漂浮碎屑，判断压差。
先松开排流口，再将小囊压力导入升降膜。
乘膜托台升至侧窗，从旧伤裂隙返回外部。
levels.reward: 压力观察升级；前往肺叶的捷径先可见、后可用。
levels.return: 拿到浮膜后可越过上层逆流，直达肺叶入口。
levels.idea: 两个喷气孔在头顶并列；通往颅骨的是腐败裂隙支路，不是正常气道。
levels.fail: 压力过高会泄回安全水槽；软囊可再充，避免一次破坏锁死路线。
levels.spec: Paired blowhole pressure well, a branching airway cross-section with two outlets SIDE BY SIDE on dorsal head, not one in belly. Two thin organic pressure bladders feed one taut translucent lifting membrane in a water current. Hero on safe side ledge controls a natural flap; rising particles clearly show stream. Bottom storyboard closeups: observe swollen membrane, open vent flap, ride membrane into side fissure. Show sealed upper shortcut visibly beyond reach. Muted cyan, minimal bubbles.

levels.name: 鲸口门庭
levels.color: baleen ivory, deep navy, small amber sound halos
levels.goal: 学会短鸣与长鸣，穿过两道鲸须筛。
play: 观察虾群穿过鲸须的节奏。
短鸣分开第一道须板；在舌面下陷前换脚。
长鸣保持第二道缝隙，再借水流滑入咽部。
levels.reward: 骨鸣器基础回声；第一段三音歌纹。
levels.return: 获得锚钩后可攀鲸须根部，找回隐藏的母鲸记忆。
levels.idea: 鲸须音高与纹路一一对应，耳骨终章会重用，玩家无需背谱。
levels.fail: 舌面有明显下陷预兆；失败冲回附近舌脊。
levels.spec: Mouth chamber with upper hanging flat BRISTLED baleen plates, no pointed teeth. Strong side view, broad curved tongue ridges create temporary soft platforms. A shrimp stream passes narrow bristle openings, tiny hero sings with U bone fork to part a gate. Three distinctive notch shapes on baleen encode a song. Bottom storyboard observe shrimp filter, short ring opens slit, long sustained ring keeps next slit open while tongue depresses. High hidden niche above shows mother's memory shard.

levels.name: 食道滑井
levels.color: muted plum, clear slime, turquoise side pocket
levels.goal: 在高速下滑中读路，并发现一条逆流支线。
play: 第一坡学习松手减速、贴褶皱刹车。
按鱼骨与气流地标选择下段，滑向胃部。
在安全兜底池观察上方秘密，借浮膜回访。
levels.reward: 滑行控制；胃部入口与后期回流目标。
levels.return: 取得浮膜后逆流抵达盲鳗侧洞，连接肠道。
levels.idea: 通往其他器官的道路是破损侧壁和组织间隙，食道主路仍指向胃。
levels.fail: 分叉前设观察停靠台；错误分支落回缓冲池，不反复重跑全段。
levels.spec: Esophagus diagonal descending side-view cutaway, folded plum membranes, distinct slick central slide and rough brake folds. Food path clearly ends in stomach chamber to right. One torn sidewall opens turquoise hidden upward water pocket, not natural pipe into heart. Hero slides feet first with readable grounded pose, fish bones guide main route. Bottom: brake at rough fold, choose lower fish-bone ramp, land safely while seeing upper secret. No shipwreck inside.

levels.name: 胃库沼泽
levels.color: olive acid, black silt, cream mucosa
levels.goal: 用四个功能胃室完成调液、软壳与漂台组合谜题。
play: 在观察室试拉胃瓣，让浮台随液位升降。
把可软化的钙壳塞推入酸池，打开旁路。
借漂浮残骸跨到总阀，排出浑浊液，返回高处门。
levels.reward: 共生抗酸膜：允许短时接触酸性液；腹侧回外部路线。
levels.return: 回访低液位侧槽，收集网线和觅食记忆。
levels.idea: 水下以密度分层的浑浊酸液界面表现“水位”；不把全场画成露天湖面。
levels.fail: 安全岛和酸膜刻度明确；操作胃瓣可逆，关键塞体有替代件。
levels.spec: Four interconnected exaggerated gastric chambers shown in one side-view organic room sequence: teaching reservoir, shell-softening basin, buoyant-debris crossing, large terminal organic valve. Underwater OLIVE DENSE ACID LAYER has visible boundary below clearer water, NOT an open air lake. Tiny hero pushes calcium shell stopper down slope; cream mucosa platforms and black silt. Fishing line, small hook and plastic fragment only, NO whole ships or huge anchors swallowed by whale. Bottom storyboard lower interface, soften shell plug, raise buoyant stepping raft and reach valve.

levels.name: 肺叶迷雾
levels.color: smoky pearl blue, delicate white membranes
levels.goal: 学会浮膜浮升，并保留通往最后一口气的完整支撑。
play: 观察支气管水流，在再充囊旁套上共生浮膜。
分两段释放压差，乘膜上升并在侧台落脚。
绕过脆弱主支架，进入保存海面记忆的薄膜囊。
levels.reward: 浮膜浮升；返回喷气孔井上层的双向捷径。
levels.return: 旧地图的高位平台与胃部上缘秘密开放。
levels.idea: 柔软组织削弱回声，改用漂粒流向和膜纹振动读路；大气泡只是记忆视觉。
levels.fail: 非关键膜可损坏并缓慢补充；主路另有旁梯，不因误刺失去收集。
levels.spec: Lung branching bronze-pale bronchi and delicate pearl blue alveolar membranes filled with turbid water. Hero carried by a translucent symbiotic manta-like floating membrane mantle in current, NOT standing atop a soap bubble. Two safe rest ledges divide ascent, fragile main support visibly taut. Distant luminous intact memory sac contains tiny vision of ocean surface, clearly magical memory. Bottom storyboard refill mantle at vent, steer to side ledge around sharp edge, preserve support to reach last-breath sac. Airy sparse pale silver-blue.

levels.name: 心室潮泵
levels.color: dull burgundy, violet shadows, pale valve edges
levels.goal: 疏通血巢群，让压力脉冲把营养送出胸腔。
play: 观察血巢群的松散、聚集、冲流三态。
在低压拍拖动诱饵，依次打开三个凝血瓣。
对准亮起的节拍环发出共鸣，让群落随排流迁出。
levels.reward: 脉冲共振；心室与肋骨间的大通道。
levels.return: 排流后中央高危通道变为安全近路，原路侧壁露出共同游弋记忆。
levels.idea: 死去的心脏由外部压差挤动，不描写为复活或持续自主心跳。
levels.fail: 预告环、声音和可选震动同步；错拍只退回避流台，诱饵可回收。
levels.spec: Heart chamber side-view boss ARENA with three organic valve niches around a broad trough, dull burgundy folded heart wall. External pressure squeezes chamber, visible incoming pressure membrane; NOT living beating monster. Bloodnest boss is many tiny scarlet amphipod scavengers, individually visible, forming a loose flow. Tidekeeper draws them using bait toward OPEN outlet at right, refuges on both sides. Bottom storyboard dispersed swarm, attracted spiral and three released valves, single flow flush leaving clear shortcut. Pale rim pulses communicate timing.

levels.name: 肝脏脂库
levels.color: amber wax, liver umber, limited poison chartreuse
levels.goal: 调配灯光、滑行和减速点，穿过污染囊区。
play: 在肝叶边缘遮住菌灯，观察嗅脂甲壳的觅食方向。
把可移动菌垫放到斜坡末端，滑过黏脂槽。
引开甲壳并绕过毒囊，取出密封灯芯。
levels.reward: 菌灯聚光升级；油脂斜坡与肠道侧路。
levels.return: 修复两处菌垫后形成长期安全通道，外部鲸脂伤口可进出。
levels.idea: 肝区与皮下脂库是两个邻接子区，用裂隙连接；水下照明为密封菌灯，不靠裸火。
levels.fail: 毒囊有颜色、形状和颗粒三重预告；破裂可用吸附菌片修复，不永久扣结局。
levels.spec: Two clearly linked subsections: dark lobed LIVER on left, thick amber BLUBBER immediately under upper skin to right, joined by a torn connective fissure. Golden slick slope descends toward cyan bacterial brake pad, poison blisters isolated off main route. Hero shields sealed lamp while scent-sensitive armored scavenger follows distant bait glow. Bottom: place brake pad, low controlled slide, recover sealed glowing lamp culture. No fire, no oil combustion, no underground warehouses.

levels.name: 肠道环城
levels.color: earth red loops, teal biofilm, shell-white landmarks
levels.goal: 用锚钩控制三圈路线，帮助居民迁居并打开侧洞。
play: 沿单向流到贝壳地标，观察同一物件重复出现。
挂住锚点暂停漂移，把食物托盘送给搬壳蟹。
在第三次返回时利用新啃出的洞走出环路。
levels.reward: 蠕动锚钩；肠道至食道隐藏回路和肋骨通道。
levels.return: 旧地图的移动膜、骨环锚点和牵引物可用。
levels.idea: “三圈变化”由喂食和水流操作触发；固定地标可靠，地图标明柔性通道变化而不故意造假。
levels.fail: 循环出口有退出支路；关键居民不会被必杀，诱饵取自可再生腐屑。
levels.spec: Intestinal loop chamber with three tiered organic curved tubes, same shell landmark conspicuous at crossing. No human town: crabs build small shell nests, amphipods shelter behind plastic scrap, bivalves line flow. Hero anchors coral-red tether to preexisting loop of connective tissue while pushing food tray for carrier crab. Bottom storyboard same shell landmark on three passes: blocked food fold, feeding colony, newly opened side tunnel. Coherent looping side-view path, earthy red and teal.

levels.name: 肋骨穹顶
levels.color: ivory arches, near-black blue, tiny gold shrimp
levels.goal: 用锚钩与骨音完成第一段大跨度攀爬。
play: 先在低位完整肋骨练习调律，观察稳定轮廓。
挂锚摆荡至中段，借三音顺序稳定松动骨桥。
避开红冠食骨虫的侵蚀区，登上脊椎入口。
levels.reward: 骨音调律；进入脊椎交通主线。
levels.return: 胃、心室和外部的骨环机关开放；主通路保留稳定承重段。
levels.idea: 食骨虫画成嵌入骨面的红色羽冠与根状组织，不画成会追人的巨型牙虫。
levels.fail: 断桥下有接住玩家的菌毯侧台；红冠密度和骨裂纹提前表达风险。
levels.spec: Grand open whale rib arches natural ivory, no masonry. Main side-view platform route goes low left rib to mid-height hanging tendon ring to upper right spine; hero swings coral-red tether then lands on stable bone. Beautiful tiny gold shrimp and translucent jellyfish, dark negative space. One thin bridge has clusters of small RED FEATHERY Osedax-inspired crowns rooted in bone and hairline erosion, not giant toothed worm. Bottom: sound-stabilize loose joint, anchor swing, choose intact rib over eroded shortcut.

levels.name: 脊椎长廊
levels.color: chalk ivory, cyan threads, distinct station pigments
levels.goal: 稳定三个椎骨段，建立往返器官的交通线。
play: 观察松动椎骨在水流中偏转的周期。
在稳定拍调律并锚定，通过断椎。
激活已探索支路的骨音节点，选择图形与音色一致的目的地。
levels.reward: 已激活节点之间的骨音迁移；头部与尾部两方向开放。
levels.return: 返回胃、肺、心室、肋骨与鲸口无需重跑长段。
levels.idea: 节点用图形、节奏和颜色共同识别；站点编号不声称对应真实椎骨序号。
levels.fail: 传送只连接已到达节点；错拍退到上一稳固骨台。
levels.spec: One continuous dorsal vertebral chain, coherent side view sweeping left to right. Three unstable joints rotate slightly in currents while stable broad vertebrae form safe platforms. Organ side entrances below marked distinct natural shape symbols: shell fan, three grooves, spiral, not digits or subway signs. Hero tunes joint with fork while anchor tether braces it. Old healed diagonal fracture recurs as landmark. Bottom: observe tilted bone, brace and stabilize, select activated resonance node represented by shape and pulse.

levels.name: 颅骨圣殿
levels.color: warm ivory, smoky ice blue memory
levels.goal: 用已收集的记忆建立鲸歌的前后关系。
play: 进入空颅，选择三个骨槽中的记忆碎片。
在短可操作片段里跟随母鲸、避开船影、寻找海面光。
对比相同歌纹，调整记忆顺序，打开耳骨裂隙。
levels.reward: 记忆拼接；终章耳骨谜题的上下文与歌纹记录。
levels.return: 缺少的可选片段会在地图上标出已见过的区域，不强制全收集。
levels.idea: 错误排列产生不同片段与线索，不碎掉道具；环境故事保留解释空间。
levels.fail: 所有骨槽可随时重排，退出片段回到原台。
levels.spec: Empty cranial vault with smooth compact ivory bone, very few props. Three organically recessed memory grooves on safe floor, hero inserts thin translucent bone memory shard. Above appear hazy fragmented vignettes mother and calf, ship propeller shadow, ice and surface light, not huge literal glass balls everywhere. Ear-region fissure beyond small arch. Bottom: choose three shards with matching notch motifs, playable calf follows mother silhouette, reorder two shards to make faint passage visible. Gentle quiet composition.

levels.name: 耳骨回声室
levels.color: near black, very thin silver outlines, restrained amber
levels.goal: 把前面听过的三段歌纹接成完整回应。
play: 观察骨纹轮廓，短鸣显影第一段踏面。
调整频率与停顿，让两组轮廓重合。
使用已记录歌纹拼出回应，保持最后一段静默。
levels.reward: 最后鲸歌；尾部释放装置的最终同步条件。
levels.return: 可返回补齐可选记忆，获得更完整的终章声景。
levels.idea: 声音、波形、骨纹和可选触觉等价提示；不要求音准、不强迫纯听觉通关。
levels.fail: 错音只让轮廓淡出并给相邻频段提示，不销毁记忆。
levels.spec: Intimate dense earbone complex, asymmetrical tympanic bone compact pear shape with small delicate inner loops, not giant fantasy cochlea castle. Near-black scene with thin silver contour revealing THREE stepping surfaces only during resonance. Hero stops listening with U fork held low; subtle notch SHAPES correspond to three frequency patterns. Bottom storyboard short sound reveals outline, match two waveform contours visually, quiet held pause lights final doorway. No enemies, no text, large darkness intentionally.

levels.name: 尾椎断崖
levels.color: dark ocean opening to luminous teal ecology
levels.goal: 同步已修复的浮膜、骨音与水流，让压住的生态出口开启。
play: 在尾根检查压力流、骨桥和歌纹三个明确状态。
沿稳定尾椎到达最后骨环，完成一次低压同步。
尾鳍轻抬后跟随幼体流游出，回望成为栖息地的鲸体。
levels.reward: 完成主线；根据已恢复的栖息点呈现不同生态丰度，可回访修复。
levels.return: 结局后返回释放前状态，未完成的修复与记忆仍可探索。
levels.idea: 尾鳍是水平的两片软组织，不长手指骨；运动来自浮力与松动结构，不是复活。
levels.fail: 系统未就绪会明确指出缺项并开捷径；不因玩家通关快而突然判失败。
levels.spec: Final tail root side-view traverse into open deep sea. Small vertebrae END BEFORE broad horizontal TWO soft tissue tail FLUKES; NO finger-like bones inside flukes. Taut gas-membrane floats and a water-current lift subtly raise one resting edge above seabed, revealing a passage full of tiny amphipods and larvae. Hero on last stable bone ring sings while creatures exit beneath, not attacking boss. Bottom: three distinct ready-state symbols on pressure membrane bone ring and song notch, small lift frees blockage, hero swims beside larvae as whale becomes quiet habitat.
